title.narrative: Feeder Road Construction in support of Trade and Market development in South Sudan

description.narrative: The objective is to improve rural livelihoods by providing sustainable access to agricultural markets using appropriately engineered infrastructure approaches. The expected benefits include: increased agricultural production enhanced by improved access to markets for agricultural produce and inputs. This is expected to gradually diversify the economy from oil dependency to agricultural and pastoral farming as well as fishing; Reduction in transports costs and subsequently the costs reduction of production and provision of services to enhance market price competition for goods and services in rural communities Improved access to vulnerable communities by humanitarian Actors Improved road infrastructure that can facilitate and ease the implementation of a range of other developments projects such as, health care, education and so forth. Within this framework, the project is expected to deliver the following results: i) Approximately 120 km of roads upgraded to virtually year-round access standards; ii) improved stakeholder capacity (State Ministries of Physical Infrastructure, contractors, communities, labour) to plan and maintain feeder roads.

title.narrative: Number of KM of feeder roads constructed and Maintained

description.narrative: Total Kilometers of feeder roads constructed, rehabilitated and maintained to all weather access, meeting the requirements of South Sudan Low Volume Road Manual

comment.narrative: No roads had been constructed at the beginning of the project.

The final target is 171.5 km. Lot 1 Kangi Bar Urud 28 km Lot 1.1 Bar Urud Kayango 20 km Lot 2 Achol Pagong Makuac Ayien 26 km Lot 2.1 Ayien Palienth 18 km Lot 3 Gok Machar Mayom Angok 35 km Lot 4 Aluakluak Mapurdit Aguran 27 km.
Lots 1 2 and 3 are ready and taking over certificates have been issued 89 km. Lot 1.2 has also completed 21.7 km of construction without handover. Total is 110.7 km
